title: Longest increasing path in a matrix
statement: Return the length of the longest strictly increasing path in a grid, moving up, down, left or right. Up to 200 × 200.
complexity: O(RC log RC) (sort) or O(RC) (memoised DFS)

solution.explanation: Four-directional moves usually mean graph search, but "strictly increasing" makes the graph a DAG (no cycles), so DP is valid. Process cells in decreasing value (a topological order) or memoise a DFS. The snake-shaped test is a single path of 40,000 cells: a recursive DFS in Python overflows; the sorted iterative order doesn't. (Part 4.2 + Part 6.)
